abstract: Chapter 8 explores The Cosmic Vision through the lens of Jnana, revealing the universal truths woven into the Mahabharata narrative.
objectives: Understand the role of Jnana in The Cosmic Vision.
Analyze key character motivations in Chapter 8.
Connect philosophical teachings to real-world ethics.

content_blocks.content: The narrative of Chapter 8 centres on The Cosmic Vision. The characters face choices that test the boundaries of Jnana — the cosmic order that governs all actions.

content_blocks.english_translation: You have a right to perform your duty, but not to its fruits.
content_blocks.content: This verse defines selfless action — the bedrock of the Gita's teaching.
Jnana as explored in The Cosmic Vision reveals that true freedom lies in detachment from outcome while remaining fully committed to righteous action.
By the end of Chapter 8, the reader understands that the battlefield of Kurukshetra is also the battlefield of the human mind — where every soul must choose between ego and truth.
